title: Valmiki Ramayana — Aranya Kanda
source_owner: Ralph T. H. Griffith translation (1870-1874) via Project Gutenberg; Sanskrit companion-only
revision_note: P1 Starter canonical ingestion per RAMAYANA_CANONICAL_SOURCE_PLAN.md Stage 2: Griffith public domain translation, Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
प्रविश्य तु महारण्यं दण्डकारण्यमात्मवान् ।
ददर्श रामो दुर्धर्षस्तापसाश्रममण्डलम् ॥
content.transliteration:
praviśya tu mahāraṇyaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamātmavān |
dadarśa rāmo durdharṣastāpasāśramamaṇḍalam ||
content.text: Entering the deep and mighty forest of Dandaka, self-possessed and invincible, Rama beheld the peaceful hermitages of the ascetics.
content.translation: Entering the deep and mighty forest of Dandaka, self-possessed and invincible, Rama beheld the peaceful hermitages of the ascetics.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book III, Canto I. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
स्नेहाच्च बहुमानाच्च स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये ।
न कथञ्चन सा कार्या गृहीतधनुषा त्वया ॥
content.transliteration:
snehācca bahumānācca smāraye tvāṃ na śikṣaye |
na kathañcana sā kāryā gṛhītadhanuṣā tvayā ||
content.text: Through deep affection and high reverence I remind you, not instruct you: never let unnecessary violence be done by your drawn bow without cause.
content.translation: Through deep affection and high reverence I remind you, not instruct you: never let unnecessary violence be done by your drawn bow without cause.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book III, Canto IX. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तः प्रियो यस्ते प्रियंवद ।
अलङ्कृत इवाभाति येन संवत्सरो शुभः ॥
content.transliteration:
ayaṃ sa kālaḥ samprāptaḥ priyo yaste priyaṃvada |
alaṅkṛta ivābhāti yena saṃvatsaro śubhaḥ ||
content.text: Now is that delightful season arrived, beloved of you, O gentle-spoken brother, by which the revolving year shines adorned with beauty.
content.translation: Now is that delightful season arrived, beloved of you, O gentle-spoken brother, by which the revolving year shines adorned with beauty.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book III, Canto XVI. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.

content.sanskrit:
मया त्वमभ्यनुज्ञातो गच्छ लोकाननुत्तमान् ।
गृध्रराज महावीर्य मम स्नेहात्प्रिये स्थितः ॥
content.transliteration:
mayā tvamabhyanujñāto gaccha lokānanuttamān |
gṛdhrarāja mahāvīrya mama snehātpriye sthitaḥ ||
content.text: Permitted by me, ascend to the highest heavenly worlds, O King of Vultures, mighty hero, who gave your life out of selfless love for me.
content.translation: Permitted by me, ascend to the highest heavenly worlds, O King of Vultures, mighty hero, who gave your life out of selfless love for me.
content.provenance: Griffith (1870-1874), Book III, Canto LXVIII. Project Gutenberg #51540 (public domain). Sanskrit companion-only.
